tasks.title: Implement MITM CONNECT handler with TLS decryption and DLP integration
tasks.description: Replace TCP tunnel with TLS->DLP->TLS proxy for mitm mode (R3-2)
tasks.details:
In `handle_connect`:
```rust
if ctx.mitm_enabled && !system_allowlisted {
    handle_connect_mitm(client, domain, ctx).await
} else {
    handle_connect_tunnel(...) // existing
}
```
`handle_connect_mitm`:
1. Write "200 Connection Established"
2. TlsAcceptor from cert_cache.get_or_create(domain)
3. Read decrypted HTTP request
4. DLP scan request.body (block if critical)
5. TLS connect to real server, forward request
6. Forward response back through client TLS
Buffer full request/response (no streaming v0.8).
tasks.testStrategy: End-to-end: curl through proxy detects DLP patterns (block), clean requests pass through, transparent mode unchanged, system_allowlist bypasses MITM.

tasks.title: Create multi-platform Dockerfile and GitHub Actions workflow
tasks.description: Docker image <50MB with multi-stage build, auto-publish on tag (R4)
tasks.details:
Dockerfile:
```dockerfile
FROM rust:1.85-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release
FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates
COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/agentshield /usr/local/bin/
EXPOSE 18080 18081
ENTRYPOINT ["agentshield"]
```
`.github/workflows/docker.yml`: tag push → buildx amd64/arm64 → ghcr.io push.
tasks.testStrategy: docker build succeeds, image <50MB, runs with config, exposes correct ports.
